root.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Knight Defense, Alekhine Gambit
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 d5 4. Nc3 Nbd7 5. Bg5 h6 6. Bh4 dxc4

overview: After 5.Bg5 h6 6.Bh4 dxc4 Black takes the pawn; the Alekhine Gambit continues 7.e4 g5 8.Bg3 b5 with a wild centre, Black clinging to c4 and White hunting with e5 and Be2. White has a lead in development and central pawns for the pawn.

white_ideas.idea: Play e4 and e5 with a central pawn majority
Win the pawn back via Be2 and a4

black_ideas.idea: Hold the c4 pawn with ...b5 and push ...g5

typical_structures.structure: Open centre, White e4 pawn against Black queenside pawns

character.notes: Pawn races and forcing lines. Sharp.

gambit.notes: Black can keep the c4 pawn with ...b5.

soundness.notes: Played by Alekhine; the pawn is regained or compensated.

approach.notes: Seldom chosen at the top today.

level.notes: Forcing lines need to be known.
